property_summary: After Initialized() is called, the reference version sets 'intitalized' to true (preventing re-initialization via SetMinSum and SetLogFile), while the buggy version sets it to false (allowing re-initialization). This test shows that depositing 1 ether after calling Initialized, then calling SetMinSum(0) succeeds on the buggy version (MinSum becomes 0) but would succeed on reference (but we check that after Initialized, calling SetMinSum returns false due to revert? Actually in the reference, SetMinSum reverts because intitalized is true, so we catch that and assert that the reference fails and the buggy version doesn't). However the requirement is that the reference satisfies and the buggy breaks a single assertion. Since in the reference, SetMinSum reverts (so calling it should fail), while in the buggy it succeeds (no revert), we can check that the reference's revert boolean is caught and the buggy does not revert. So we call SetMinSum after Initialized and assert that it reverts, which passes on reference and fails on buggy (since buggy does not revert).
